11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberate design: colorblind-safe Tol palette with HCL lightness mapped to hierarchy depth is intentional and effective, full-viewport layout with clean breadcrumb and legend, but leaf-level density is high and small cells feel visually noisy at the root zoom level.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap area encoding is structurally correct (d3.treemap proportional layout, data-driven domains, categorical color) but leaf-cell lightness is randomized via seeded RNG rather than encoding any data dimension, introducing non-data visual variation that could imply spurious differences.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: interrupt() is correctly called before new transitions, but the named root-transition end handler (t.on('end')) may silently skip the final updateVisibility call on rapid clicks, leaving label-visibility state inconsistent after interrupted zoom sequences.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 well-chosen Tol colorblind-safe hues manages categorical color right at the warning threshold; zoom-deferred detail keeps root-level cognitive load low, though many leaf labels at overview are unreadably small before interaction.
